integrity: General theorem proved by affine barycentric geometry and conditional antipodal sign counting. Exact rational and finite sampling checks are supplementary; no independent mathematical audit has been performed.
limitations: No assertion for general interior sampling, higher-dimensional simplices, or larger samples; the exact law of the externally visible facet count does not give facet areas or heights. Historical priority outside inspected sources remains provisional.
scientific_scope: Four independent possibly nonidentically distributed, antipodally symmetric random samples on the common boundary of one centered, centrally symmetric three-dimensional convex body; every affine plane has zero mass.
title: Distribution-free visible-facet law for tetrahedra inscribed in centrally symmetric convex surfaces
